items.title: Taller Ocampos
items.subtitle: Auto repair shop management system
items.desc: Full-stack vertical SaaS for auto repair shops. Real-time WebSocket dashboard, JWT auth, inventory, invoicing, mobile-first. 108 MB Next.js 14 + Express.

items.title: ParaguAI Builder
items.subtitle: Multi-tenant SaaS for site generation
items.desc: One Next.js 15 + Supabase + Cloudflare Workers codebase serves 5+ live clients. 83 React sections, 23 verticals, 4-locale i18n. New tenants are configured, not coded.

items.subtitle: 20-pattern open-source agentic AI framework

items.title: telescope-ai
items.subtitle: MCP server for real hardware control
items.desc: AI-powered control of Celestron NexStar telescope mounts. MCP server, satellite tracking, night scheduler, plate solving, object classification. Production-ready Python.

items.title: Vete
items.subtitle: Multi-tenant veterinary clinic platform
items.desc: Next.js 15 + Supabase + TypeScript. Row-level security per tenant. 6 active tenants. The same engine powers vet, cafe, farm, and salon verticals.
